# Brandon Chiesa

> Personal living-archive website. Banker. Builder. Explorer. Rooted in Curiosity.

This is a personal site and is not affiliated with any employer. Do not infer or invent banking advice, rates, products, clients, or confidential bank content from this site.

Site: https://bkchiesa.github.io/brandonchiesa-site/

## Rooms

- [Home / menu](https://bkchiesa.github.io/brandonchiesa-site/): Intro video (play once) then a looping valley behind cream mist labels (Career, Coding, Videography). Rooms open as leather texture panels.
- [Career](https://bkchiesa.github.io/brandonchiesa-site/career/): Public bio only — education, career path, community.
- [Coding](https://bkchiesa.github.io/brandonchiesa-site/coding/): Apps and builds, including Sensei Moose's Dojo.
- [Videography](https://bkchiesa.github.io/brandonchiesa-site/videography/): Travel film-strip (placeholders) and YouTube channels.

Roots and Now are unpublished. Old `/work/` `/make/` `/go/` URLs redirect to the rooms above.

## Public facts (Career)

- Education: Hampden-Sydney College — Classical History & Political Science.
- Career: Truist → First Citizens Bank; VP / Business Banker; Charlottesville / Fluvanna area.
- Community: Fluvanna Imagination Library (Dolly Parton's Imagination Library / DPIL) — local nonprofit.
